cues.text: Midnight in 1616 Edo Japan. A lone blindfolded samurai guarded the Bridge of One Hundred Blades.
The Shogun offered ten thousand gold coins to any warlord who could cross. Ninety-nine had fallen.
When the demon executioner stepped forward, the blindfold dropped. In two breaths, lightning struck the water.
Honor is eternal. Would you dare step onto this bridge? Drop your answer below.
